label: Bible Study
prompt: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh _____;
verse: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
note: Paul's chain reaction — tribulation, patience, experience, hope — and hope doesn't disappoint.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for _____ and might are his:
verse: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
note: Daniel's praise after God revealed the king's dream to him in a night vision.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild _____ his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verse: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
note: A well-meaning cook shredded wild gourds into the prophets' stew — and the next verse finds out why that was a mistake.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early _____ it goeth away.
verse: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
note: Israel's devotion vanished like morning mist — gone before the day really started.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be _____.
verse: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
note: Written in bonds (1:13): Paul says he 'learned' to be content — it didn't come naturally even to him.
